ValidationRule.description: Prevents an objection from being closed without a resolution and resolution note being provided
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Provider_Objection", OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - No Action"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed")), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Resolution__c, ""), AND(ISBLANK(Resolution_Notes__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Resolution__c, "Logged in Error"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter a resolution and resolution note in order to mark this objection as closed
